title: 语法八课 · 英语句子 = 一支乐队

bandIntro.title: 🎼 主线比喻：英语句子 = 一支乐队
bandIntro.note: 你是乐团团员，乐队的逻辑你身体里已经有了。你不需要记语法术语，只需要认出乐队里的角色。

roles.band: 指挥的起拍手势——不发声，但全团知道要开始了
曲子的调——定了调不能中途转
谱面记号——小，但少一个就走样

hiddenLineText: 「越常用的词，越不规则」——当你发现这不是一堆乱七八糟的例外，而是同一条规律在反复出现，整个英语就变得有秩序了。

lessons.title: be 动词：英语的等号
lessons.hiddenLineNote: be 是英语里最常用的动词，所以它最不规则：am / is / are / was / were 长得完全不像一家人——它是几个古老词根缝起来的「缝合怪」。越常用，越不规则，这是第一次遇见这条规律。

sections.text: 中文说「我很开心」，不需要「是」。英文必须写 I am happy——be 就是英语的等号。想想数学：写「3+2 5」谁看得懂？等号没了，句子就断了。英文里 I very happy 就是「3+2 5」。
am 只跟 I；is 跟一个人/一件东西（he, she, it, my dog）；are 跟你和一群（you, we, they, my friends）。
was = am/is 的过去；were = are 的过去。讲昨天的事，等号也要换成昨天的。
后面是「什么样 / 是什么 / 在哪里」的时候：I am eleven. She is a violinist. They are in the music room. 后面是动作（play, run, eat）就不用 be——动作自己会当节拍。

examples.en: I am in the school orchestra.
My violin is old but beautiful.
We were tired after the concert.
I play the violin every day.
examples.note: 有动作 play → 不用 be

lessons.accept: 验收：给 6 个中文句子口头翻译，「等号句」全都带上 am/is/are/was/were，「动作句」全都不多加 be。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：不用讲语法。她说出 I very happy 时，只重复一遍正确的 I am very happy 让她跟读，不解释为什么。一天抓三次就够。

exercises.q: I ___ eleven years old.
exercises.explain: I 只配 am。

exercises.q: My best friend ___ good at drawing.
exercises.explain: 一个人 → is。

exercises.q: We ___ at the concert last night.
exercises.explain: last night 是过去，we → were。

exercises.q: 改错：I very hungry now.
exercises.explain: 「什么样」的句子必须有等号 am。

exercises.q: 改错：She is play the piano every day.
exercises.answer: She plays the piano every day.
exercises.explain: 有动作 play 就不要 be——等号和节拍不能同时抢一个位置。

exercises.q: The books ___ on the desk yesterday.
exercises.explain: books 是复数 + yesterday → were。

exercises.q: The music room ___ next to the library.
exercises.explain: 一间教室 → is。

exercises.q: My shoes ___ wet because of the rain.
exercises.explain: shoes 复数 + 现在 → are。

exercises.q: I ___ at my grandma's house last weekend.
exercises.explain: last weekend + I → was。

exercises.q: Look! The baby pandas ___ so cute!
exercises.explain: 复数 + 现在 → are。

exercises.q: My father ___ a doctor. He works at the city hospital.
exercises.explain: 「是什么」→ 等号 is。

exercises.q: 改错：She very tall.
exercises.explain: 红区错误2：「什么样」的句子缺等号。

exercises.q: 改错：They was late for school yesterday.
exercises.answer: They were late for school yesterday.
exercises.explain: they 配 were。

exercises.q: 改错：I am agree with you.
exercises.explain: agree 是动作，动作句不要多加 be——等号和节拍不同时上。

exercises.q: 把句子变成过去（昨天）：I am at the music club.
exercises.answer: I was at the music club.
exercises.explain: am 的昨天形状是 was。

exercises.q: 口头验收：翻译成英文——我的书包很重。
exercises.answer: My school bag is very heavy.
exercises.explain: 验收题：等号句必须带 is。

lessons.title: 疑问句与助动词：指挥的起拍手势

sections.h: do 是唯一没有意思的词
sections.text: do/does/did 自己没有任何意思，它只负责举手——像指挥的起拍手势：不发声，但全团知道要开始了。问句把它举到句首，全世界就知道你在提问。

sections.h: 四百年前的英国人也说 Like you music?
sections.text: 莎士比亚时代的英语真的把动词直接搬到句首提问。后来英语改了规矩：动词不许动，派 do 去句首站岗。所以 You like music? 不是错得离谱，是晚了四百年。
did 已经举了「过去」的牌子，后面动词就回到原形：Did you watch...? 不是 Did you watched。一支乐队只需要一个指挥。

sections.h: be 动词的句子不用请 do
sections.text: be 自己就是等号，自己会走到句首：Are you ready? Was she late? 只有动作句才需要 do 来帮忙。

examples.en: Do you like pop music?
Does your brother play football?
Did you practise the violin yesterday?
examples.note: did 标过去，practise 回原形

examples.en: Are you in Grade 6?
examples.note: be 句自己上，不请 do

lessons.accept: 验收：任给陈述句，3 秒内改成疑问句和否定句。如 She likes cats. → Does she like cats? / She doesn't like cats.
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：玩「快问快答」——你说中文问题（你喜欢…吗？），她 3 秒内说英文问句。她漏了 Do，你只把 Do 补在句首重复一遍。

exercises.q: 把陈述句改成疑问句：You like ice cream.
exercises.explain: 请 do 到句首举手。

exercises.q: 改成疑问句：She plays tennis on Sundays.
exercises.answer: Does she play tennis on Sundays?
exercises.explain: does 举手后 plays 变回 play——时态只标一次。

exercises.q: 改成否定句：They went to the zoo.
exercises.answer: They didn't go to the zoo.
exercises.explain: did 标了过去，went 回原形 go。

exercises.q: 改错：You like music?（书面）
exercises.explain: 8 类错误第 1 类：问句缺助动词，会挡意思。

exercises.q: 改错：Did you watched the film?
exercises.explain: 时态只标一次：did 举了牌，watch 回原形。

exercises.q: ___ your sister at home now?
exercises.explain: at home 是「在哪里」的 be 句，be 自己上。

exercises.q: 改成疑问句：Your sister likes drawing.
exercises.explain: she → does，likes 变回 like。

exercises.q: 改成疑问句：They watched a film last night.
exercises.answer: Did they watch a film last night?
exercises.explain: did 标过去，watch 回原形。

exercises.q: 改成否定句：I like carrots.
exercises.explain: 否定也要请 do：do not / don't。

exercises.q: 改成否定句：He went to the party.
exercises.answer: He didn't go to the party.
exercises.explain: didn't + go（原形）。

exercises.q: ___ your grandpa drink tea every morning?
exercises.explain: 第三人称单数 → Does。

exercises.q: ___ you at school yesterday?
exercises.explain: at school 是 be 句，be 自己上：Were you…?

exercises.q: What time ___ the shop open on Sundays?
exercises.explain: the shop 单数 → does。

exercises.q: 改错：Does she likes music?
exercises.explain: 时态和人称只标一次：does 举了牌，like 回原形。

exercises.q: 改错：You went where yesterday?（书面）
exercises.explain: 疑问词到句首 + did 举手 + go 原形。

exercises.q: 3 秒验收：改成疑问句——She plays chess.
exercises.explain: 验收标准：3 秒内完成这个变形。

lessons.title: 一般现在 vs 过去：动词自带时间戳
lessons.hiddenLineNote: went 原本是另一个动词 wend 的过去式，被 go 借来就没还——最常用的 go 连过去式都是借的。又一次：越常用的词，越不规则。40 个不规则动词之所以不规则，恰恰因为它们是英语里最有用的 40 个。

sections.h: 中文动词 vs 英文动词
sections.text: 中文动词像一张没有日期的照片，时间写在便签上（昨天/明天/正在）。英文动词自带日期戳：play 是今天的，played 是昨天的——动词自己变形来报时。
每天都发生、一直是真的 → 用原形（he/she/it 加 -s）：I practise every day. The sun rises in the east.
昨天、上周、去年发生完的 → 动词盖过去戳：规则的加 -ed（played, watched），不规则的换形状（go→went, eat→ate）——40 个常用的要专门背（见不规则动词闯关）。
every day / usually / often → 现在；yesterday / last week / ago → 过去。看到信号词先定调，再选动词形状。

examples.en: I practise the violin every evening.
Last Saturday we visited my grandma.
examples.zh: 上周六我们看望了奶奶。

examples.en: She goes to school by bike.
We ate noodles and then went home.
examples.zh: 我们吃了面然后回家了。

lessons.accept: 验收：给一组带信号词的句子，10 题里 8 题以上能选对现在/过去，并把不规则动词写对。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：晚饭时玩「昨天今天」：她说一件今天常做的事（英文），再把同一件事说成昨天做过的。只听动词有没有变形。

exercises.q: I ___ my homework at seven every day.
exercises.explain: every day → 现在，I → 原形 do。

exercises.q: We ___ a bird show at the zoo last Sunday.
exercises.explain: last Sunday → 过去戳 -ed。

exercises.q: Tom ___ to music club on Fridays.
exercises.explain: 习惯 + he → goes。

exercises.q: Yesterday I ___ (eat) two eggs for breakfast.
exercises.explain: eat 是不规则动词，过去式 ate。

exercises.q: She ___ (buy) a new dress last week.
exercises.explain: -ought 家族：buy→bought。

exercises.q: 改错：I go to the beach last summer.
exercises.answer: I went to the beach last summer.
exercises.explain: last summer 要过去戳：go→went（借来不还的那个）。

exercises.q: My grandma ___ me a story every night when I was small.
exercises.explain: when I was small → 过去，tell→told。

exercises.q: Water ___ at 100 degrees.
exercises.explain: 事实永远为真 → 一般现在，water 三单加 s。

exercises.q: Last night I ___ (sleep) for ten hours!
exercises.explain: 尾巴变 t 家族：sleep→slept。

exercises.q: She usually ___ (go) home by bus.
exercises.explain: usually → 现在，she → goes。

exercises.q: We ___ (see) a rainbow on the way home yesterday.
exercises.explain: 独行侠：see→saw。

exercises.q: My little brother ___ (draw) a cat on my homework last night!
exercises.explain: -ew 家族：draw→drew。

exercises.q: 改错：I eat two eggs this morning.（现在是晚上）
exercises.answer: I ate two eggs this morning.
exercises.explain: 今天早上已过去 → ate。

exercises.q: 改错：He runed to school because he was late.
exercises.answer: He ran to school because he was late.
exercises.explain: run 是不规则动词：run→ran，不加 -ed。

exercises.q: 把句子说成昨天：I sing in the music room.
exercises.answer: I sang in the music room.
exercises.explain: i→a 家族：sing→sang。

exercises.q: 验收：把这句说成习惯（every day）：I drank milk yesterday.
exercises.explain: 过去戳换回现在形状。

lessons.title: 现在进行 + 时态一致：别在半路转调

sections.text: 此刻正在做 → be + 动词-ing：I am doing my homework now. 注意两件套缺一不可——没有 be 的 I doing 和没有 -ing 的 I am do 都不成立。
拉琴时 G 大调拉到一半突然转降 E，全场都会皱眉。写故事也一样：开头用了过去时，整个故事就是过去调，中途不能跳回现在。
看图写故事最容易犯：When they are in the lake they ate...（前半现在、后半过去）。写之前先默念：这个故事发生在过去 → 每个动词都盖过去戳。
写完只检查一件事：把每个动词圈出来，问「它是过去形状吗」。一个不是，改成是。

examples.en: Look! The cat is sleeping on my violin case.
examples.zh: 看！猫正睡在我的琴盒上。

examples.en: One sunny morning, Lily walked to the park. She saw a small dog and gave it some bread.
examples.zh: 一个晴朗的早晨，莉莉走去公园。她看见一只小狗，喂了它一些面包。

examples.en: While we were playing, it started to rain.
examples.zh: 我们玩着玩着开始下雨了。
examples.note: 过去进行 + 一般过去，仍是过去调

lessons.accept: 验收：看三幅图口头讲一个 5 句的故事，时态从头到尾不跳。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：她讲英文小故事时，你不用懂内容，只数动词——听到 is/am/are 混进过去故事里就轻敲一下桌子当「转调提醒」。

exercises.q: Listen! Someone ___ the piano.
exercises.explain: Listen! → 此刻正在 → be+ing。

exercises.q: Last night, Mia ___ a picture and hung it on the wall.
exercises.explain: last night 定了过去调。draw→drew。

exercises.q: 改错：Yesterday Tom went to the river and swims with his friends.
exercises.answer: Yesterday Tom went to the river and swam with his friends.
exercises.explain: 故事已定过去调，swims 是半路转调。swim→swam。

exercises.q: 改错：She is do her homework now.
exercises.answer: She is doing her homework now.
exercises.explain: 进行时两件套：be + -ing，缺一不可。

exercises.q: When I saw him, he ___ under a big tree.
exercises.explain: 过去的正在进行 → was/were + -ing。

exercises.q: 把句子改成正在进行：They play basketball.
exercises.explain: be(are) + playing。

exercises.q: Be quiet! The baby ___.
exercises.explain: 此刻正在 → is sleeping。

exercises.q: Yesterday at eight, we ___ dinner with Grandpa.
exercises.explain: 过去某一刻正在 → were having。

exercises.q: She ___ TV when the phone rang.
exercises.explain: 过去进行 + 一般过去：正在看时电话响了。

exercises.q: Look out of the window! It ___ (snow)!
exercises.explain: Look! → 正在下雪。

exercises.q: 改错：Last Sunday we go to the zoo and saw pandas.
exercises.answer: Last Sunday we went to the zoo and saw pandas.
exercises.explain: 红区错误3：故事定了过去调，go 是半路转调。

exercises.q: 改错：When I opened the door, the cat is sitting on my bed.
exercises.answer: When I opened the door, the cat was sitting on my bed.
exercises.explain: 过去的故事里 is → was。

exercises.q: 改错：They are play football now.
exercises.explain: 两件套：are + playing。

exercises.q: 连成一句故事(全过去)：图1 Tom 在跑步 / 图2 他摔倒了
exercises.answer: Tom was running and he fell down.
exercises.explain: 过去进行 + fell（fall→fell），全程过去调。

exercises.q: 把句子改成正在进行：She reads a book.
exercises.explain: is + reading。

exercises.q: 验收：看图讲故事第一句(过去调)——一个女孩在公园放风筝
exercises.answer: One day, a girl was flying a kite in the park.
exercises.explain: 开头定调：One day + 过去形状。（意思对即可）

lessons.title: 介词：at 是点，on 是面，in 是盒子

sections.text: at = 0 维的点（at the bus stop 站在那个点上）；on = 2 维的面（on the table 贴在面上）；in = 3 维的盒子（in the box 装在里面）。
时刻是点 → at seven, at noon；日期那天是面 → on Monday, on May 1st；月份年份季节是大盒子 → in June, in 2027, in winter。
in Saturday 是黄区错误：不挡意思，但 Part 5 直接扣分。星期几永远 on。
by car / by bus（乘车）、on holiday（度假）、at school（在学校）——这些当一个词背，不拆开想。

examples.en: The concert starts at seven on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 音乐会周五晚上七点开始。
examples.note: 时刻 at + 具体某天晚上 on

examples.en: My cat likes sleeping in a shoe box.
examples.zh: 我的猫喜欢睡在鞋盒里。

examples.en: Your keys are on the piano.
We go to school by bus.

lessons.accept: 验收：Part 5 格式的介词填空 4/6 以上。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：家里随手指东西问「点、面、还是盒子？」——钥匙在桌上（面 on）、袜子在抽屉里（盒 in）、约定七点（点 at）。中文就能玩。

exercises.q: My birthday is ___ October.
exercises.explain: 月份是大盒子 → in。

exercises.q: See you ___ six o'clock!
exercises.explain: 时刻是点 → at。

exercises.q: We play football ___ Saturdays.
exercises.explain: 星期几永远 on（in Saturday 是 Part 5 最爱抓的错）。

exercises.q: There is a map ___ the wall.
exercises.explain: 贴在墙面上 → on。

exercises.q: We went to Shanghai ___ train.
exercises.explain: 交通方式搭配 by train，整块背。

exercises.q: The pencils are ___ my school bag.
exercises.explain: 书包是盒子 → in。

exercises.q: School starts ___ eight o'clock.
exercises.explain: 时刻是点 → at。

exercises.q: We visit Grandma ___ Spring Festival.
exercises.explain: 节日整体常用 at：at Spring Festival。

exercises.q: My birthday is ___ the fifth of June.
exercises.explain: 具体日期 → on。

exercises.q: It often snows here ___ winter.
exercises.explain: 季节是大盒子 → in。

exercises.q: The cat is sleeping ___ the piano.（在钢琴上面）
exercises.explain: 贴着面 → on。

exercises.q: Your socks are ___ the washing machine.
exercises.explain: 洗衣机是盒子 → in。

exercises.q: I cut the paper ___ scissors.
exercises.explain: 用工具 → with scissors。

exercises.q: 改错：See you in Monday morning!
exercises.explain: 具体某天(早上) → on。黄区错误4。

exercises.q: 改错：We went to Shanghai with train.
exercises.answer: We went to Shanghai by train.
exercises.explain: 交通方式 → by train，整块背。

exercises.q: 验收（Part 5 形状）：The concert is ___ Saturday evening.
exercises.explain: 具体某天的晚上 → on Saturday evening。

lessons.title: 代词 + 限定词：a 是新朋友，the 是老朋友

sections.h: a 的前世是 one，the 的前世是 that
sections.text: a 从 one 磨损而来——「某一个、第一次提到」；the 从 that 磨损而来——「就是那个、你知道的那个」。所以：第一次出现用 a（新朋友），再次提到用 the（老朋友）：I saw a dog. The dog was hungry.
考纲限定词只有两个用法：a + 可数单数；the + 可数/不可数。不用背复杂规则。
做主奏用 I / he / she / we / they；站在动词后面挨「打击」用 me / him / her / us / them：He helped me.（不是 He helped I）。
口语常听到，但书面要写 Tom and I（做主语时）。Part 5 黄区考点。

examples.en: I bought a book. The book is about space.
examples.zh: 我买了一本书。这本书讲太空。
examples.note: 新朋友 a → 老朋友 the

examples.en: Tom and I are in the same class.
Miss Lee teaches us music.
Can you pass me the salt?

lessons.accept: 验收：Part 5 格式的冠词/代词填空 4/6 以上。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：读英文小故事时让她圈 a 和 the，每圈一个说「新朋友还是老朋友？」。玩三次就有感觉。

exercises.q: There is ___ orange on the plate. (a/an/the)
exercises.explain: 第一次提到 + 元音开头 → an。

exercises.q: I have a cat. ___ cat is black and white. (a/the)
exercises.explain: 第二次提到，老朋友 → the。

exercises.q: My grandpa often tells ___ funny stories.
exercises.explain: 动词后面 → 宾格 us。

exercises.q: ___ and I went fishing yesterday.
exercises.explain: 主语位置：Tom and I（不是 Me and Tom）。

exercises.q: Is this ___ pen or mine? (your/you)
exercises.explain: 名词前用物主代词 your。

exercises.q: 改错：I have book.
exercises.explain: 可数单数第一次提到要 a——黄区错误，Part 5 直接考。

exercises.q: I saw a bird. ___ bird was drinking water. (a/the)
exercises.explain: 第二次出现 → 老朋友 the。

exercises.q: Do you want ___ apple? (a/an)
exercises.explain: 元音开头 → an。

exercises.q: This is not my pen. It's ___.
exercises.explain: 句尾单独用 → hers（她的东西）。

exercises.q: Our teacher gave ___ a lot of homework.
exercises.explain: 动词后 → 宾格 us。

exercises.q: ___ bag is this? — It's Tom's.
exercises.explain: 问「谁的」→ Whose。

exercises.q: Look at ___! He can dance!
exercises.explain: 介词 at 后 → 宾格 him。

exercises.q: 改错：Me and Lily are in the same class.
exercises.answer: Lily and I are in the same class.
exercises.explain: 黄区错误5：主语位置用 I，且先说别人。

exercises.q: 改错：She is an university student.
exercises.explain: university 读音以 /j/ 开头（you），用 a 不用 an——看读音不看字母。

exercises.q: 改错：I have dog. Dog is very cute.
exercises.answer: I have a dog. The dog is very cute.
exercises.explain: 第一次 a（新朋友），第二次 the（老朋友）。

exercises.q: 验收（Part 5 形状）：填一词——Where is ___ nearest bus stop?
exercises.explain: 最高级前面 → the。

lessons.title: 连接词：连奏线

sections.text: KET 考纲连接词只有 7 个：and, but, or / when, where, because, if。像连奏线把两个音连成一句，让句子不再一个个蹦。
and 加一句、but 转折、or 二选一：I like apples and bananas. I can sing but I can't dance.
when 什么时候、where 什么地方、because 为什么、if 如果：I was happy because we won.
连接词不光 Part 5 考，还直接抬高写作的 Organisation 维度分——25 词的小作文里放一个 because 和一个 then，就从「蹦豆子」变成「有线条」。

examples.en: I practised hard, and I passed the test.
examples.zh: 我努力练习，然后通过了考试。

examples.en: I like music because it makes me happy.
examples.zh: 我喜欢音乐，因为它让我开心。

examples.en: Call me when you get home.
If it rains, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果下雨我们就待在家。

lessons.accept: 验收：用 because / but / when 各口头造一句，25 词小作文里自然用上 2 个连接词。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：她说任何一句英文后，你问一声 Why?，引导她加 because…。这是最便宜的写作提分动作。

exercises.q: I wanted to go out, ___ it was raining.
exercises.explain: 想出门 ↔ 下雨，转折 → but。

exercises.q: Do you want tea ___ juice?
exercises.explain: 二选一 → or。

exercises.q: I was late ___ I missed the bus.
exercises.explain: 说原因 → because。

exercises.q: ___ you are free tomorrow, let's play chess.
exercises.explain: 如果 → if。

exercises.q: I lived in a town ___ there was a big lake. (when/where)
exercises.explain: 挂地方 → where。

exercises.q: 用 because 把两句连成一句：I like winter. I can skate.
exercises.answer: I like winter because I can skate.
exercises.explain: 连奏线 because 连接结果和原因。

exercises.q: Hurry up, ___ we will miss the train!
exercises.explain: 「否则」→ or。

exercises.q: I was tired, ___ I finished my homework.
exercises.explain: 累 ↔ 仍完成，转折 → but。

exercises.q: We can't play outside ___ it is raining.
exercises.explain: 给原因 → because。

exercises.q: I was doing homework ___ you called me.
exercises.explain: 「…的时候」→ when。

exercises.q: This is the shop ___ I bought my violin strings. (when/where)
exercises.explain: 挂地方 → where。

exercises.q: ___ you finish early, we can play chess. (If/But)
exercises.explain: 条件 → If。

exercises.q: 用 but 连成一句：I can swim. I can't dive.
exercises.answer: I can swim but I can't dive.
exercises.explain: 转折用 but。

exercises.q: 用 when 连成一句：I was five. I started school.
exercises.answer: When I was five, I started school.
exercises.explain: when 挂时间。

exercises.q: 改错：I like music. Because it makes me happy.（两句合一）
exercises.answer: I like music because it makes me happy.
exercises.explain: because 把原因挂在主句后面，不单独成句。

exercises.q: 验收：用 because 口头说一句你喜欢的东西和理由
exercises.answer: I like winter because I can skate.
exercises.explain: 意思通顺即可——写作口语都靠这个句型。

lessons.title: 量词 + 比较级：中文认为万物不可数
lessons.hiddenLineNote: good→better→best、bad→worse→worst——最常用的形容词，比较级最不规则。第三次遇见同一条规律：越常用的词，越不规则。现在你可以确认：这不是巧合，是英语的秩序。

sections.h: 中文 vs 英文的数数观
sections.text: 中文认为万物不可数，所以全要量词：一「本」书、一「条」鱼、一「杯」水。英文只认一半：书鱼苹果自己能数（two books），水面包米不能数，要借杯子袋子（a glass of water, a piece of bread）。
能数的用 many（many books），不能数的用 much（much water），a lot of 两边通吃——不确定就用它。
短词加 -er（taller, faster）；长词前面放 more（more beautiful）。为什么？你念念 beautifuler——念不出来吧？语言是懒的，怎么顺口怎么来。
A 比 B → A is taller than B。最高级前面要 the：the tallest in our class。

examples.en: How many eggs do we need?
There isn't much milk in the fridge.
A violin is smaller than a cello.
This is the most interesting book in our library.
examples.zh: 这是我们图书馆最有趣的书。

lessons.accept: 验收：可数/不可数分类 10 词对 8 个；用比较级和最高级各口头造一句。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：超市里玩分类——「这个英语里能直接数吗？」苹果能、大米不能。判断错了不纠正，回家查了明天再问一次。

exercises.q: How ___ water do you drink every day?
exercises.explain: water 不可数 → much。

exercises.q: There are ___ birds in the park in spring.
exercises.explain: birds 可数复数，a lot of 通吃。

exercises.q: An elephant is ___ (big) than a horse.
exercises.explain: 短词 -er，注意双写 g。

exercises.q: This film is ___ (interesting) than that one. (用 more…)
exercises.explain: 长词前放 more——beautifuler 念不出来，语言是懒的。

exercises.q: Winter is the ___ (cold) season of the year.
exercises.explain: 最高级 the + -est。

exercises.q: 改错：I ate three bread this morning.
exercises.answer: I ate three pieces of bread this morning.
exercises.explain: bread 不可数，要借「片」：pieces of。

exercises.q: How ___ brothers do you have?
exercises.explain: brothers 可数 → many。

exercises.q: There isn't ___ juice left in the bottle.
exercises.explain: juice 不可数 → much。

exercises.q: Can I have a ___ of water?
exercises.explain: 水借杯子数 → a glass of water。

exercises.q: Today is ___ (hot) than yesterday.
exercises.explain: 短词 -er，双写 t。

exercises.q: This is the ___ (good) noodle shop in our town!
exercises.explain: 暗线第三站：good→better→best，最常用最不规则。

exercises.q: My bag is heavy, but yours is ___ (heavy).
exercises.explain: y 变 i 加 -er。

exercises.q: Maths is ___ than English for me.
exercises.explain: 长词前放 more——difficulter 念不出来。

exercises.q: 改错：I drank two milks this morning.
exercises.answer: I drank two glasses of milk this morning.
exercises.explain: 牛奶不可数，要借杯子。

exercises.q: 改错：She is taller then me.
exercises.explain: 比较用 than，不是 then（然后）——拼写陷阱。

exercises.q: 验收：用最高级说一句你们班/乐团里的事
exercises.answer: Lily is the youngest player in our orchestra.
exercises.explain: the + -est + in 范围。（意思对即可）
